subject: Salesforce timeline harmonization — Q3 commit clean sweep
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Parks <jordan.parks@parkwell.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Salesforce timeline harmonization — Q3 commit clean sweep

Team —

Quick housekeeping before we lock Q3 commits. I pulled a short export (attached) and need a 48-hr sprint to align stages and close timelines so finance has a clean commit picture by EOD Thursday. Please do the following for any opps assigned to you in the attached CSV: 

1) Confirm the correct Stage and Close Date. If the expected close slipped beyond 60 days, either move to an appropriate later close-date or mark as Stalled/Uncommitted.
2) For deals with no activity in the last 90 days, add a one-line internal note with the next plan (e.g., "touching base w/ buyer 6/28" or "archive if no reply by 7/5").
3) If you're unsure about qualification, change the Forecast Category to "No Commit" and ping me.

Record completion by updating the Salesforce record and adding the tag "Q3-Hygiene-2027" in the deal notes. If you think an opp should be archived, start a short thread with me + Naomi and include the key reason.

Attachments: CommitSweep_EXPORT_20270620.csv; Hygiene_Playbook_Q3.pdf

Thanks — small lift, big impact for forecast accuracy.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Salesforce timeline harmonization — Q3 commit clean sweep

Monica —

Thanks for the heads up. I'm on it and will start with the 18 deals flagged as "No Activity >90d." Quick question: for opps flagged as "Ghost (no contact >180d)", do we want to archive now or create a recovery sequence and set a follow-up task? I can push the recovery cadence if leadership prefers retention.

I see a couple of high-dollar ops where the buyer has been unresponsive for >6 months; happy to propose archival candidates and loop in AE leads for sign-off.

— Dylan
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Salesforce timeline harmonization — Q3 commit clean sweep

On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 8:07 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Monica —
>
> Thanks for the heads up. I'm on it and will start with the 18 deals flagged as "No Activity >90d." Quick question: for opps flagged as "Ghost (no contact >180d)", do we want to archive now or create a recovery sequence and set a follow-up task? I can push the recovery cadence if leadership prefers retention.
>
> I see a couple of high-dollar ops where the buyer has been unresponsive for >6 months; happy to propose archival candidates and loop in AE leads for sign-off.

Good question. Decision tree: 
- If ARR < $15k and no activity >180d → archive (set Stage = "Archived - No Response", add note with last contact date).
- If ARR >= $15k → create a 3-touch recovery cadence over 30 days (email + call + executive intro) and set a follow-up task; AE must own the cadence.

For the high-dollar opps you called out, please draft a two-line rationale for each and send to me + Naomi for quick sign-off. I'll take anything that looks salvageable into a short review with AE leads Wed afternoon.

Also: Vivek — can you push the "Q3-Hygiene-2027" tag to the global list so it appears in our SF saved views? Naomi — please prep a one-slide summary of the final counts (archived / recovery / committed) for Finance by Thu EOD.

Thanks all — this will tighten the commit substantially.

— Monica
From: Jordan Parks <jordan.parks@parkwell.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha@parkwell.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Salesforce timeline harmonization — Q3 commit clean sweep

Monica —

Appreciate the transparency on the cleanup. Aisha and I will review our side and confirm whether any of the Parkwell opps flagged should remain active. If we decide to archive, we'll keep a short note with the last meeting date.

One ask: can you share a short list of the fields you check when deciding "Archived - No Response" so our ops team can mirror the labels in our CRM? That would make sync easier.

Thanks — Jordan
VP Partnerships | Parkwell Systems
jordan.parks@parkwell.com
